name: EXM_AIRFARE_POLICIES
description: This table contains details of all airfare policies.

columns.name: AIRFARE_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of this airfare expense policy.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of this expense policy of airfare category.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for this expense policy of airfare category.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Airfare policy status, such as Draft and Active. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether airfare rates vary based on the role of an employee.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type that determines the policy rate, such as Job, Grade, and Position. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_ROLE.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLIGHT_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether airline ticket class vary based on the flight type.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLIGHT_DURATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether airline ticket class vary based on the flight duration.

columns.name: FLIGHT_DURATION_CODE
columns.description: Allows expense manager to choose the flight duration type, if it is per whole trip or per leg. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_AIR_FLIGHT_DURATION.

columns.name: POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Type of airfare expense policy enforcement applied. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_ENFORCEMENT.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether airfare expense policy warning is displayed to user.
